description: Smarte Strasse: Sensoren is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Kantons- und Stadtentwicklung. Im Rahmen des Projekts «Smarte Strasse» wurden Sensoren an verschiedenen Standorten angebracht. Weitere Informationen und Daten rund um das Projekt «Smarte Strasse» finden Sie unter den folgenden Links: Weitere Informationen zum Projekt «Smarte Strasse»: Weitere Datensätze rund um das Thema «Smarte Strasse»:. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Territory and environment, Mobility and Transport, Energy. Its keywords are Parkplatz, Ladestationen, Luftqualität, Verkehrslärm. The portal shows 6 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-01-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
